annotation.title_clean: Report from the Commission on the Review of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (Digital Markets Act), in accordance with Article 53
annotation.title_en: Report from the Commission on the Review of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (Digital Markets Act), in accordance with Article 53
annotation.summary_en: European Commission's first review report on the Digital Markets Act under Article 53. It finds the DMA has made digital markets fairer and more contestable and is fit for purpose, needing no amendment. It flags AI and cloud computing as focus areas, favouring enforcement, guidance and transparency improvements. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: DMA is fit for purpose and does not need to be amended at this stage
AI services and cloud computing are priority areas, with market investigations and specification proceedings opened
Too early to extend interoperability obligations to online social networking services
Plans to improve transparency, procedures, templates and cross-regulatory cooperation via the High-Level Group
Seven gatekeepers designated for 23 core platform services; fines imposed on Apple and Meta
